task.description:
SECOND RETRY after bench env fix. Run the full E2E test suite on branch feature/WF02-f2b-shoulds-20260529. Bench env is now fixed.

IMPORTANT: Use the wrapper script to verify bench: .vscode/run-zig-bench.ps1 (reads .env before running zig build bench)

Steps:
1. Run: powershell -File .vscode/run-zig-bench.ps1  (if it doesn't exist, run zig build bench directly after setting env vars from .env)
2. Start the backend server (use start-backend.ps1 which also reads .env)
3. cd web && npx vite --port 4173 &
4. Wait for both servers, then: cd web && npx playwright test
5. Write results to tests/reports/
